contract: Create exactly the requested number of .eml files for each titled date period; combine all periods in one output folder
acceptance: The folder contains exactly one .eml file for each manifest entry

contract: Templates set seed to 0; plans must specify seed; derive a separate random seed for each email and content field
acceptance: Same inputs and software versions produce identical email files and batch.astrea-manifest.json

contract: Require an .astrea-plan.json file for generate; read fixtures titled date periods languages profiles seed parameters and limits from it; save the full plan in the batch
acceptance: No generation-setting CLI overrides; replaying the saved plan with the same installed software produces identical files and checksums

contract: Generate every selected case at least once in each period before repeating cases
acceptance: Reject periods whose counts are below the coverage minimum; report counts by period and fixture

contract: Future proposal: control fixture proportions while keeping thread groups complete; not supported by the current plan format
acceptance: Produce each period count exactly; use fixture IDs to break allocation ties; reject counts that cannot fit complete groups

contract: Start with English European Latin-script languages Japanese and Arabic RTL; add more languages in later releases
acceptance: Core fixtures cover en_GB en_US fr_FR de_DE es_ES it_IT ja_JP ar_EG; check characters encoding and text direction

contract: Use separate named sets of client headers and provider headers; allow only supported combinations
acceptance: Each manifest entry identifies the two profiles and expected headers

contract: Generate standard sender recipient date subject and MIME headers; add reply list and delivery headers when requested
acceptance: Check header values order repeated headers and encoding; Bcc is absent from the .eml file by default

contract: Support ASCII and UTF-8 text; use CRLF line endings and a specified transfer encoding
acceptance: Decoded text and character encoding match the expected values in batch.astrea-manifest.json

contract: Support HTML-only emails and emails with both plain-text and HTML versions; escape inserted text
acceptance: No scripts forms tracking remote assets or links outside configured .test domains

contract: Attach reviewed PNG JPEG PDF TXT and CSV assets or a safe generated email with predictable names and contents
acceptance: Attachment type size filename and SHA-256 checksum match the manifest

contract: Embed images as MIME parts and reference them with cid: links in the HTML
acceptance: Each cid: link points to exactly one embedded image in the same related group

contract: Generate simple multipart emails and nested parts with a requested depth; enforce part-count limits
acceptance: Part paths types order and nesting depth match the manifest

contract: Generate related emails with Message-ID In-Reply-To and References; support an attached email using message/rfc822
acceptance: Reply links point to generated emails; thread dates increase; attached emails have their own IDs

contract: Support 7bit quoted-printable and base64; encode non-ASCII headers with RFC 2047 and filenames with RFC 2231
acceptance: Check both encoded file bytes and decoded text or attachment contents

contract: Phase 2: support ISO-8859-1 Windows-1252 ISO-2022-JP and GB18030; add a separate profile for raw UTF-8 headers
acceptance: Reject text that the chosen encoding cannot represent; never silently replace characters

contract: Write batch.astrea-manifest.json with one entry per .eml file: source fixture checksum and expected headers text parts and attachments
acceptance: Tests can find each file and check what should be present or absent; expectations come from the fixture rules

contract: Require both explicit stress-case selection and include_stress: true in the plan; generate deep wide or intentionally malformed emails within fixed limits
acceptance: Record each deliberate error or stress parameter and the expected safe parser response

contract: Check maximum files bytes parts headers depth and attachments before and during generation
acceptance: Reject requests exceeding limits; leave no completed output folder after failure

contract: Generate locally from packaged templates and attachments without sending email or fetching content
acceptance: Generation works with networking disabled; all attachment contents are reviewed and passive

contract: Check file checksums attachment contents expected headers selected cases and normal MIME structure
acceptance: Detect changed or missing files; check planned errors in stress cases without unbounded parsing

contract: Return stable error codes; optionally write error details as JSON
acceptance: Exit 0 for success; 2 for invalid requests; 1 for file-access errors or failed output checks

feature: List options and preview a batch
contract: List available fixtures profiles languages packs and limits; show a generation plan without writing emails
acceptance: JSON output is repeatable for the same inputs

contract: Read domains from a plan JSON array or a local text file with one .test domain per line; assign them repeatably across email fields
acceptance: Same normalized domain list yields identical output from either source; only configured domains appear; replay needs no external file

contract: A plan contains multiple titled ISO date ranges with exact counts; distribute email dates repeatably within each range
acceptance: January 30 plus February 55 yields 85 files; each file has its period ID and a Date within the range; threads stay within one period
